name: IDEX420
pre_gcode: M140 S{bed_temp}   ; p3d: need to heat the bed
M190 S{bed_temp}   ; p3d: wait for bed temperature
M104 S{temp}       ; p3d: need to heat the nozzle
M109 S{temp}       ; p3d: wait for nozzle temperature
G90 ; switch to absolute coordinate mode
G1 F18000 Y-160 Z15 ; move fast to the coordinates
G1 F18000 X0 Z0.3 ; move fast to the coordinates
G92 E0 ; set the extruder to 0
G1 F300 X60 E24 ; purge the hotend
G1 F600 X40 ; swipe the nozzle
G1 F600 Z3 ; perform Z hop
